title: Harshit P Probable NDE 13128
content: My friends and I were having fun. They mixed marijuana in my drink without telling me. I am allergic to marijuana because it triggers my panic attack disorder. The doctor strictly told me not to take marijuana again, or else you will die. After drinking my drink, I started experiencing a panic attack. It was like I was having a heart attack. I told my friends to take me to the hospital but they wouldn't do it. Instead, they locked me in house with themMy mouth starts to dry and I felt all the symptoms of dying. Suddenly, a white light came to me. I felt like I was in an out of body state. I could hear friends' thoughts as they were sitting by my side. Then from the white light, our Hindu God shri Krishna came and asked me to come with him. On the other side of that light, there is so much peace and on opposite sidewas so much chaos. All past events are revised in my mind. It felt like I could see the future of my parents after my death. God is forcing me to come with them, but I am in bit confused. After my death, there is nobody to take care of my parents. Slowly, I realized that I am dead and I should go with God or otherwise I became Ghost. After some time, my friends try to wake me up. I can see them, but can't feel any sensation. God told me that if I want to go with my friends, then I can't come with him. Suddenly, my friends throw water in my face. I became a little conscious then. After 3 to 4 hours, I understand that I am not dead. After this incident, I became more religious. I am fearful if this happens again because I don't know what to do. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: July 2024 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Allergic Reaction Drug or medication overdose. Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I see the God asking me to come with him. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. At the time of experience it's like I am more focused At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Whole time when I am with God Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. I felt like there is no time Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Blurry vision through which I can see my friends and future Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Hearing was normal Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain It's not a tunnel but clouds with white light. I am on downside of this tube of clouds and God on upper side. The clouds form like a wall. On the other side of that wall is complete peace Did you see any beings in your experience? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Family members Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. A place where there is complete peace and feels like heaven What emotions did you feel during the experience? I feel very furious Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? I remembered many past events. Very past events revised in my mind. Those I don't remember in daily life Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future. I saw my parents future become hell after my passing Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. Yes, god told me that if I completely agree, then I can go with him, but not otherwise God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Hindu In Hinduism we have faith like after death God comes to take us and past events are revised Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I became more religious What is your religion now? Hindu Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Now I strongly believe in God Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. I saw Lord Krishna asking me to come with them Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Yes Lord Krishna During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes I can see heaven with my bare eyes During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes God was in front of me Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I feel like I now have a supernatural power of dying with my own wish During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes My father's future stopped my going with god Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes I encountered with how hard it became for my parents after my death During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. After the incident, I became more spiritual and religious Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Now I feel like I can only die if I want to die Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I tell others, but they didn't understand Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No onvpkjb_nde
